alcohol.answer: flydubai allows alcohol in both hand baggage and checked baggage. Retail-packaged drinks above 24% and below 70% alcohol are limited to receptacles of 5 litres and 5 litres per passenger; drinks of 24% or less have no restriction.

sections.p: From the flydubai Dangerous goods page (restricted and prohibited items), read on 22 November 2026. Its Conditions of Carriage also say passengers may not drink alcohol on board unless flydubai serves it.

head: Question
flydubai rule
rows: Retail packaging, receptacles up to 5 litres, 5 litres net per passenger
Country (origin, destination and transit) and customs rules apply

list: Not on the page: flydubai does not say here how the 100 ml cabin liquid limit applies to bottles bought after security; duty-free items are size and weight checked at the gate.

faq: How much alcohol can I take on flydubai?
24% alcohol or less has no restriction; above 24% and below 70% it is limited to 5 litres per passenger in retail packaging, in receptacles up to 5 litres.
Can I put alcohol in hand baggage on flydubai?
The Dangerous goods page marks alcoholic beverages as allowed in both hand and checked baggage, within those limits and subject to country and customs rules.
